purpose: fix Community14 character voice decoding and reduce/correct Vita dialogue text stalls/layout drift

voice_fix.problem: Community14 top-level wav payloads were passed toward SoundEffect as if they were PCM although compressed streams use the APK loader's PlayStation ADPCM framing
voice_fix.solution: decode verified Community14 wav wrappers to signed 16-bit mono PCM before the unchanged original SoundEffect path
voice_fix.format: 16-byte PS-ADPCM frames -> up to 28 PCM samples, predictor/shift in frame byte 0, terminator/control in byte 1

text_fix.problem: Vita PVF backend rasterized glyphs repeatedly, derived line metrics from each individual string and uploaded the full text surface even for small changes
solution: cache PVF glyph masks by size/codepoint
cache font-wide line metrics and use baseline equivalent to Android Paint FontMetrics top/bottom semantics
track dirty row ranges and upload only affected rows with glTexSubImage2D
log text uploads taking at least 15 ms for hardware profiling

confidence: BUILD CONFIRMED + HOST RESOURCE REGRESSION; voice quality, text placement and stall reduction require physical Vita confirmation
next_test: Android14 profile: enter a real battle, trigger multiple character voices and dialogue boxes, compare voice clarity/completeness, text alignment and stalls; preserve runtime.log for Text upload timing lines
